subject.title: fix(mcp): reject mixed command+url transport config (#72111)

question: Should an MCP server definition containing both `command` and `url` be a permanently invalid canonical configuration, or must OpenClaw support an explicit launch-a-local-HTTP-server workflow?
rationale: The current stored shape admits both fields while the proposed branch makes it fail only at runtime; choosing a canonical config contract and upgrade behavior requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Make transports mutually exclusive
options.body: Recommended: reject mixed fields in config validation and add a focused doctor repair or diagnostic so existing users receive a deterministic upgrade path.

options.title: Define explicit launch-plus-HTTP semantics
options.body: Retain both fields only if maintainers want a supported lifecycle contract for spawning a local HTTP MCP server, with an explicit schema mode and lifecycle proof.

recommendation.title: Make transports mutually exclusive
recommendation.body: Recommended: reject mixed fields in config validation and add a focused doctor repair or diagnostic so existing users receive a deterministic upgrade path.
